text: I went for a tool adjustment on May 18, 2026, and had another appointment scheduled for June 22, 2025. Upon arrival, the staff said there was no longer an appointment scheduled for the 22nd, as they hadn't written it down on the appointment slip. I went again on the 22nd, and they said there was no appointment slip and the next appointment was on the 29th, even though they had already confirmed the 22nd appointment. This was a huge waste of time. The information wasn't clear from the start, and they didn't even write it down on the appointment slip. I'm very dissatisfied and feel like I wasted a lot of time.
